page.notes: Three columns, read left to right; the first column begins under the Genesis heading and continues in the second and third. The title block at the top is set in capitals with letter-spacing; the line "INDEX LOCORVM SACRAE SCRIPTVRAE" is printed as "SCRI" with the last letter cut off at the right edge, so the final word is read as SCRIPTVRAE from the continuation line. The last line of the third column is cut off at the foot of the scan and is partly illegible; the Latin there reads as best as the scan allows. Some numerals in the right column are uncertain (e.g. "94", "21.b") and the printed "Pro afflu" may be a misreading of "Profluu". Printed as shown in the scan.
